notes.title: Early Access is live!
notes.content:
The Eternal Hunt is now in Early Access!



This is a Closed Beta phase focused on feedback and iteration. 

DISCLAIMER: The game is not in a final state, there will be bugs, there will be content missing and it will not be perfect!


Join now if you are interested in helping shape the game, have your feedback listened to and make this the best ARPG it can be! 



Full content and price reductions will follow in stages.

 

See below for changes between the latest Demo patch and the current Early Access patch.

 
New Content:
Added Vial Recipes to the Jewellers Crafting Bench. This enables Players to craft “Random Vial”, “Random Vial for Subclass”, “Random Minor Vial for Subclass” and “Random Augment Vial for Subclass”. The recipes drop in the world, and have the same level requirements and material requirements as usual!

Added 5 Skills to each Base Class:

Mage: Blink, Arcane Sphere, Elemental Surge, Mana Conduit and Runic Barrier.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555788/a921b108233316a51ad1fd28e4851973409b0df2.png"]



Warrior: Storm Bola, Warrior’s Advance, Battle Roar, Ground Slam and Endure Pain.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555788/8711b75beb101cbd071939536d4b73848883b733.png"]



Ranger: Power Shot, Quickstep, Hunter’s Mark, Nature’s Grasp and Windcaller Focus.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555788/4b4875514880e35567dc505c81a45646443991cb.png"]



Necromancer: Death Pulse, Rotting Pact, Soul Chain, Gravewalk and Dark Insight.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555788/cfe0d42d9c59effed52e041fd6b957ad00e430f9.png"]

Added Manuscripts (and Vial drops) for Flame Nova (Pyromancer), Raise Skeletons (Summoner), Whirlwind (Barbarian) and Rain of Arrows (Archer).

Enabled Global Chat.

Enabled Auction House.

Enabled User Authentication System.

Added social media buttons to the Main Menu.

Updated the endgame hub “Sanctuary” to be more in keeping with an epic town ready for when Persistent Hubs (you can see other players) is turned on!

Added Quests to the Adventure Arena. There is a Main Quest line that takes you through all 8 Arenas and then Side Quests that offer good rewards for beating the challenges!

Added Quests to Sanctuary that introduces each endgame NPC. These Quests will continue into individual quest lines that will take you through each stage of the content and provide incremental rewards.

Added voice acting for every NPC in the game.



Bug Fixes:
Mother Griffon had her debug box showing for Swoop.

Increased Evasion was missing a % sign on the Affix tooltip.

Fixed tooltips for Hybrid Passive Nodes.

Fixed a bug that could cause Codex to not open using the UI button.

Fixed a bug that would cause a weird layout of the Codex to appear.

Weather sound effects are now tied to the Ambient volume slider.

Removed unused actions from the Keybindings settings.

Fixed a bug with the Search function in the Passive Trees.

Fixed a bug that caused Codex Points to not be added under certain circumstances.

Deathquake now properly accounts for other damage increases such as “Increased Physical Damage”.

Fixed a bug that caused Materials and Currency to not drop from Enemies.

Fixed a bug that caused Loot to sometimes drop too high off the ground, meaning it was unlootable.

Fixed a bug that caused 2 members of a Magic Pack to not have Affixes.

Fixed a bug with the Two-Handed Hammer walk/run animations.

Fixed a bug that caused Summons to not behave properly after a certain amount.

Fixed a bug that caused the wrong portrait to show in top right hand corner of Passive Trees.

Fixed orientation on Shield meshes.

Fixed a bug that could cause a weird character rotation when interacting with things such as the Stash.



Balancing and QoL:
Chests no longer vanish after 20 seconds of not being opened, they now only vanish 5 seconds after being opened.

Slightly reduced the initial volume of Storm sound effects.

Increased the size of the Search box in Auction House slightly so it doesn’t cut off the bottom of certain letters.

Included a section in the Passive Tree tutorial about how to move around the Path.

The first Passive Tree (Path) you are shown is suitable for your Subclass so you don’t have to move through them to find a good one to put your first point in!

Made Passive Tree starting nodes more obvious from a distance.

Escape now closes any open Codex windows.

Doubled the drop chance of Legendary Items.

Loot Labels have a reduced chance of overlap (can still occur with huge amounts of loot on screen to avoid it being pushed off screen!).

Removed single passive node resets.

Passive Tree respecs are free until level 70, at which they cost an increasing amount per level (capped at level 100).

Added a 30% movement speed penalty to Whirlwind.

Removed the Level restrictions on Items rolling as Magic/Rare/Epic (5/15/25) as they didn’t provide the intended effect and just led to the negating of early fun!

notes.title: Thank you for playing!
notes.content:
Thank You for Playing The Eternal Hunt – What’s Next?


Over the past week, more than 1,700 players joined the hunt during Steam Next Fest and I am incredibly grateful for the support!



Your feedback and bug reports have already helped shape the game with 2 hotfixes and 1 patch dropping throughout the week and another patch well underway.



With the end of Next Fest the Demo will be removed (for now), whilst I prepare for Early Access launch.



This Early Access launch is just the first phase of the game, and you can think of it as a Closed Beta. Over the coming months, I will be:

Adding Content

Polishing balance, scaling, and progression

Improving UI/UX and accessibility



As always I am actively following feedback so if you enjoyed the Demo or want to be part of the journey please join me on Discord and the Steam Forums!



P.S Don’t forget to wishlist if you haven’t already as it really helps drive visibility!



Cheers,
Sam

notes.title: The Eternal Hunt Demo is now Live!
notes.content:
The Time Has Come!


The Demo release marks the culmination of a year and half of part time work so I am happy people finally get a chance to play it! I cannot wait to hear your feedback so don't hesitate to share it with me, either here on the Steam Forums, Discord or Email.


What is included in the Demo?


Wave based Arena levelling with Normal Waves, Elite Waves and Boss Waves so you can level your way!

4 Sub Classes each with 5 Skills.

7 Passive Trees with ~50 Keystones to shape your builds!

Basic Crafting.

Advanced Crafting.

Loot Pets.

Item Filter.

Quality of Life such as Inventory management.

6 Stash Tabs.

6 Inventory Tabs (5 for Items and 1 for "Symbols" - think Diablo 2 Charms!).

~100 Legendary Items.

~50 Runewords.

Tier 1 of an Endgame mode - Fragments.

and much more!


What is not included in the Demo?


The other 8 planned Sub Classes.

Class Skills.

More subclass skills.

More Legendary Items and Runewords.

Skill Manuscripts (individual Skill Trees).

Tier 2-5 of Fragments.

Anomaly Fragments.

Khazul's Maze.

Execution Grounds.

Boss Encounters.

Auction House

Persistent Hub.

Leaderboards.


Why not!?


Because it's a Demo not a full release :D 

A lot of the content not included has been done, but will be staggered throughout different phases of development in order to make sure that everything gets fully tested and that I can gather feedback from yourselves before nailing things in!


Any Questions?


If anyone as any questions or feedback please leave it here:

Discord

Steam Forums

TheEternalHunt@Hotmail.Com

notes.title: The Eternal Hunt: Roadmap
notes.content:
The First Taste: Steam Next Fest Demo
The Eternal Hunt is coming to Steam Next Fest this June! For one full week, players can get their hands on the first playable demo and dive into the world of darkness, fire, and steel.

Choose from four powerful subclasses — Pyromancer, Barbarian, Archer, and Summoner — and battle your way through the Arena to reach the Sanctuary, where a taste of endgame content awaits!

  4 Playable Subclasses
 Wave-based Arena
 Limited Skill Tree Development
 5 Unique Subclass Skills per Subclass
 Class Skills Preview
 Unique Passive Tree per Subclass
 Legendary Gear and Runeword Drops
 First Taste of Endgame


Closed Beta: Help Shape the Hunt
After the demo closes, we'll take a short break to squash bugs and polish feedback. Then, The Eternal Hunt returns in Closed Beta Early Access!

Players can opt in by purchasing at a higher price point to gain immediate access and help shape development—plus you'll receive an exclusive supporter cosmetic as thanks.

The majority of the game’s core systems, content, and endgame foundation is already complete. Early Access is designed to refine balance, gather feedback, and roll out remaining content efficiently. This won't be an endless beta.

  Full Skill Tree Access
 Expanded Endgame Content
 More Legendaries & Runewords
 Additional Subclasses Begin Rolling Out
 Auction House (Alpha Version)
 Social Hub & Global Chat
 Achievements


Open Beta: Enter the World
Once the game hits a stable point, we’ll open the gates to all players with a price drop and full beta content unlocked. Get ready to dive deep into the evolving world of The Eternal Hunt.

  All Beta Subclasses
 More Skill Trees
 Even More Legendaries and Runewords
 Endgame Fully Online


Full Release & Beyond
The full release launches alongside our first seasonal reset. Expect leaderboard wipes, new rewards, and potentially a shift to free-to-play (with early supporter compensation if that happens).

  Seasonal Leaderboards
 Auction House Reset
 Seasonal Characters
 First DLC Subclass
 New Cosmetics
 Additional Skills (Class + Subclass)
 Even More Legendaries and Runewords


Look forward to seeing you in June!
Follow us on X (Twitter) and join our Discord for exclusive updates, patch notes, and community discussion.

The Eternal Hunt
